description: Generate or set a password for an alias. Returns the alias username and password needed for alias-authenticated endpoints (messages, folders, contacts, calendars, sieve scripts).

domain_id.description: Domain ID or fully qualified domain name (e.g. "example.com")

emailed_instructions.description: Email address to send the password and setup instructions to

is_override.description: Override existing password and delete associated IMAP storage

new_password.description: Custom password to set (leave empty for auto-generated password)

password.description: Existing password to change without deleting IMAP storage

name: generateAliasPassword
